text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph development with personal anecdote and conclusion","quality":"organizational coherence","description":"The essay holds together across several paragraphs with a clear progression from idea to example to reflection to conclusion."},{"evidence":"\"I remember one point in my life...\" and \"A few weeks passed and i told my mother\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its point with a sustained personal narrative rather than relying mainly on brief, repetitive statements."},{"evidence":"\"He told me straight up to ignore all the negative stuff...\"","quality":"sentence variety","description":"The essay uses a mix of simple, compound, and complex sentences that make the writing sound more developed and fluid."},{"evidence":"\"just by telling someone that there shoes are ugly can really change the whole person\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay explains consequences and connections between ideas instead of staying at the level of isolated observations."},{"evidence":"\"I know it sounds funny, i laugh all the time when i talk about it dont worry\"","quality":"voice","description":"The essay shows a more natural personal voice and sense of audience awareness."}]}
